Commentary.Commentary: So 374 to get from the 50 overs. Pakistan have a huge task in hand and they will need to be at their brilliant best. England batters have done their job and the onus will now be on their bowlers now. Second innings begins in a while. So join us for that one.

As for Pakistan's bowling, there was not much to tell. When a team scores in excess of 350 it is an obvious thing that bowler's would be taken to the  cleaners. Ali, Afridi and Yasir Shah were amongst the wickets column but they all went in excess of 6 runs in an over and there was not much to talk about.

The innings started off positively for England with both the opener's Roy and Bairstow getting to their respective fifties. The opener's added a mammoth 115-run stand for the opening wicket. Bairstow then departed however Root and Roy continued the good work. There was a slight break due to rain. Pakistan though benefited from it and got rid of Jason Roy and Joe Root. Pakistan though could not capitalize on it. Buttler along with his skipper added 162-run stand off just 89 balls. The right-hander was the man in charge. Though Morgan got his fifty quickly but it was Buttler who stole the show. He started from ball one and got to his 100 off just 51 balls.
Jos Buttler walks of to a standing ovation from the crowd and he is being congratulated from the Pakistan players. His carnage of 110 off just 55 balls has seen England post 373.
Just a single to end! Top, top last over. Just the 5 from it. Full and on off, Morgan shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket for one. ENGLAND FINISH WITH 373!
A couple now! Good bowling again, Shaheen bowls it wide outside off, keeping it away from Morgan's hitting zone. Morgan carves it over covers for two.
Another dot! Excellent bowling! It is full and outside off, Morgan looks to go hard through the off side but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Another one on the body of the batsman, Buttler works it through square leg for only a single. The first half of the over has belonged to Pakistan.
Well bowled! Sees Buttler making room and cramps him for room by bowling it close to his body. JB looks to cut but misses.
Length and outside off, Morgan reaches out to it and slaps it through covers for one.
Yorker on off, Morgan jams it out towards cover and gets a single.
Length ball on off, Jos hits it to point and this time gets just a one.
FOUR! This is too much from Buttler. There has been no respite for the bowler's today. Full on off, Buttler hits it over long off for a boundary.
FOUR! Excellent stuff this. Full outside off, Jos squeezes it past short third man for a boundary.

SIX! 100 for Jos Buttler. This is the 2nd fastest century for England. He has got there off just 51 balls. Full on off, Buttler thrashes it over long off for a biggie to get to his 8th century. It has been a brutal innings from him.
Low full tos son middle, EM hits it towards long on and gets to the other end.

In the air but safe. Full on middle, Buttler looks to hit it over the bowler's head but mistimes it. The ball though falls short of long on and they get a couple. 350 comes up with it. 380 on the cards?
SIX! Buttler has murdered this one. Back of a length ball on off, JB pulls it behind square for a maximum.
Back of a length ball on off, JB pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and runs two.
Full outside off, Morgan hits it to long off and gets a single. 5 runs off the first three now.
A very low full toss outside off. Almost a yorker. EM swipes it wide of fine leg and gets two.
Length ball outside off, Morgan looks to hit it over covers but does not get the desired timing on it. It falls wide of long on and they get a couple.
Shaheen Afridi is back.

SIX! Add a biggie to that! 20 from the over, a huge one. Once again Hasan is guilty of bowling it right in the slot. Full and on off, Buttler lifts it with ease over the long on fence. Buttler into the 80s.
On the shorter side on middle, Buttler pulls it through mid-wicket and takes two again. So 6,2,2,2,2 is how this over reads so far.
Once again a brace! This is a yorker outside off, Buttler squeezes it through point and takes two.
Another couple as this low full toss is hit in the gap in the mid-wicket region.
Goes full this time and on middle, Buttler mistimes it towards long off. The fielder from long on gets across and keeps it down to two.
SIX! Into the crowd again! Once again a biggie on the very first ball of the over. In the slot and angling into the batsman. Buttler clears his front leg and tonks it into the mid-wicket stand.
Full on leg side, Buttler looks to hit it but misses. The ball hits him low on the pads and goes towards point. They take a leg bye. Good over for England. 17 off it.

SIX! Good effort from Imam but cannot do much. Length ball outside off, Buttler smacks it over point. Imam in the deep runs to his right and looks to pull back the ball but it touches his fingers and foes over the ropes.
Low full toss outside off, Morgan plays it to backward point and gets a run.
Full and wide outside off. Just the length and line they need to bowl to Eoin. He hits it wide of sweeper cover and gets a couple
SIX! No need to run, no need to even think about it. In the slot outside off, Morgan accepts the invitation and demolishes it over long on for a biggie.
Full toss on leg side, Buttler hits it to mid-wicket and gets a single. 300 comes up with that single for England. They will look to get to at least 350 from here.
Fuller than the previous one on Buttler hits it hard to long off for a single to keep the strike.
SIX! That was six the moment it left the bat. Full on off, in Buttler's slot. Hasan was asking it to be hit, Buttler says thank you very much and smashes it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Length ball on off, Buttler punches it but once again straight to the same man.
Full around off, Buttler hits it hard but straight to the man at cover.
Length ball outside off, Eoin punches it to deep cover for a run.
Play and a miss. Length ball outside off, Morgan looks to hit it but misses.
Hasan Ali replaces Shaheen Afridi.
Outside off, Buttler has a slash at it but misses.
FOUR! Excellent way to get to his 19th ODI fifty. Slower bouncer on off, Buttler moves away and slashes it over point for a boundary. He raises his bat in appreciation and soaks in the applause.
Length ball on the body, Buttler taps it back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Buttler once again looks to paddle scoop but gets a bottom edge and the ball lobs to the on side.
Outside off, Buttler slaps it but straight to cover.

Fifty for the skipper. He has been excellent today. His 44th in this format. He gets to this milestone by slashing this full ball to deep cover for a single. The skipper will look to play till the end and take them to over 350.
WIDE! Poor delivery this. Length ball way outside the tramline. Though Morgan moved he did not play and it has been wided by the umpire.
Faheem Ashraf is back.
Length ball outside off, Jos hits it hard but straight to the man at point.
Good comeback. Yorker outside off, Buttler looks to play it but misses.
SIX! Two in two. Fuller on middle, it is in Buttler's area. He will punish you if you bowl it there and this one is no different. He smashes it over square leg for another biggie.
SIX! Hammered away. Length ball around off, Buttler takes his front leg out of the way and hoicks his pull over square leg for a maximum. Into 40 now.
Length ball around off, Buttler punches it off his back foot but straight to cover.
On middle and leg, Eoin flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and gets a run.
Shaheen Afridi is back.
On the pads, Buttler flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple. The running between the wickets has been excellent by these two.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full outside off, Morgan looks to reverse sweep it but misses.
Tossed up on middle, Buttler comes down the track and strokes it to long off for a run.
Flighted on off, Buttler comes down the track and blocks it.
Tossed up on middle, Jos milks it to long on. They run the first one hard and get a couple as the fielder goes after it.
Yasir Shah is back on.
On middle and leg, Buttler flicks it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Floated on the stumps, Jos blocks it.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
WIDE! Imad sprays it down the leg side, Jos looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
On the pads, Eoin strokes it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Flighted outside off, Jos pushes it towards cover and gets a single.
On middle and leg, Eoin glances it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
FOUR! Perfect execution! Length ball outside off, Buttler initially moves away to the leg side and the comes inside the line of the ball and paddle scoops it over the fine leg region for a boundary.
Well directed bouncer. It is outside off, Buttler is taken aback by surprise. He looks to pull but misses.
On the pads, Eoin flicks it to backward square leg and rotates the strike.
Slightly shorter on off, Jos pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Outside off, Eoin strokes it towards point and gets a run.
Length ball outside off, Buttler comes down the track and punches it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! 250 is up for England and in some style. Floated outside off, Morgan smashes it through covers for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Eoin flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
On the pads, Jos glances it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted on middle, Morgan strokes it to long on and gets a run.

Edge but safe. Quicker and straighter outside off, Buttler looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. Faheem runs behind it and saves it before the fence. Buttler and Morgan though run quick and gets three.
Shorter on the pads, Morgan flicks it to the on side and gets to the other end.
A single to end! This is short and around off, it is cut to third man for one.
FOUR! Aggression there by Morgan! He dances down the track and converts it into a full delivery, it is whipped through mid-wicket and a boundary results.
Back of a length on off, Buttler finally gets bat to this one and he pushes it through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! There us just nothing there! Not sure what Sarfaraz heard there. Pakistan lose their sole review. This is bowled full and outside off, Buttler goes after it but seems to have missed it. The keeper is up in an appeal and then the bowler joins in. The umpire shakes his head. Sarfaraz takes the review. Ultra Edge shows nothing.
Pakistan have taken a review for caught behind. Buttler is the man in question. He is unmoved and there was no noise but Sarfaraz is confident. Let's see what the replay's have to say.
Slash and a miss! Short and outside off, Buttler throws his bat at it but is beaten by the low bounce.
This one is angled into the batsman, Buttler works it to mid on.
Faheem Ashraf is back on!
Flighted on middle and off, Jos strokes it to long off and keeps the strike.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single
Short on off, Morgan cuts it to the man at point.
Floated on off, Morgan pushes it to cover.
Floated on middle and off, Morgan goes over mid off. He does not time it well. The fielder from long on runs and saves a boundary. Eoin once again gets a couple.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Morgan flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE! Once again Imad bowls it down the leg side and again the umpire signals wide.
Wide! Imad sprays it down the leg side, Morgan looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
FOUR! Three poor balls on the trot and Buttler has taken full toll of all three. Short on leg, Buttler smackes it over square leg for a boundary. He is on 15 already off just 4 balls.
FOUR! Once again short but not as much as the previous one. It is outside off, Jos pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! Buttler won't miss out on the lose deliveries even if you bowl it early on in his innings. Short on off, Jos gets back on his back foot and smacks it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Shorter on off, Morgan cuts it to deep point and rotates the strike.
Buttler is off the mark. On the pads, Buttler flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
The new man in is Jos Buttler.

OUT! Short ball and caught! Yasir Shah makes an impact straightaway. Root will be mighty disappointed as he has got out to a nothing delivery. Yasir bowls this one short and on middle, Root goes back and pulls it hard but does not keep it down. It goes uppishly towards Haris Sohail at mid-wicket who takes a sharp catch. Root walks back after getting off to a start. Pakistan managing to do well after the break. They need to keep picking wickets if they are to stem the run flow.
Yasir Shah is back!
Floated on middle and off, Eoin comes down the track and hits it over mid off. The fielder from long on runs to his right and pulls it back before the ropes. The batsmen take two.
WIDE! Imad misses his line and sprays it down the leg side. Wide signalled.
FOUR! Deft from Morgan. Imad tosses it up on middle, Morgan gets down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

In the air but in no man's land. Floated on middle, Morgan comes down the track and chips it towards long on. He does not time it well and it work's in his favour as it falls short of the man in deep there. They take two.
FOUR! Excellent batting here. Morgan has played him to against his field. There is protection on the leg side, Wasim tosses it up on off, Morgan drives it through covers for a boundary.
Short outside off, Root punches it to deep cover and gets a run.
Imad Wasim is back into the attack.
Good change in pace! It is the slower one and outside off, Morgan gets beaten as he ends up defending inside the line.
This one is a good short ball. Shaheen really bends his back on this one. Morgan bails out of the pull shot.
FOUR! Pulled and hit nicely! Second boundary in the over. A short delivery, it does not rises that high, easy pickings for Morgan as he pulls it through mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow! Fuller in length and on middle, this is creamed down to the long on fence.
Back of a length on off, blocked towards the off side for one.
Maiden over. Excellent from Ali. He bowls the last one on a back of a length outside off, Root defends it off his back foot to calmly see off the over.
5th dot in a row. Fuller on middle, Root looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On off, Root pushes it to the man at cover.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call it is. A low full toss on middle and leg. The ball was going away with the angle. Root looks to play it across but misses. Hasan Ali and Sarfaraz have a discussion and then the latter signals T. Replays roll in and the Hawk Eye shows the impact was in line but it was going to just about hit the leg stump. Umpire's call it is and hence Root survives. Pakistan though retain their review.
Review time! Pakistan have taken a review for an LBW. Looks to be going down leg.
Outside off, Root defends it off the upper half of the bat. It goes behind to the right of the keeper. Morgan looks for a single but does not get it.
Length ball outside off, Root punches it to man at cover.
On the stumps again, it is stroked to mid off.
Angles this one into the pads, it is worked to mid on.
Fullish and on off, this is crisply driven through covers for one.
Nicely driven! On the fuller side on off, Morgan strokes it nicely through wide mid off. The ball though due to the damp outfield stops and three from it.
Back of a length on off, it is guided through point for a single.
On the fuller side on off, it is driven to mid off.
Shaheen Afridi is back on!

FOUR!  What a way to get off the mark. Length ball outside off, Morgan gets on his front foot and drives it exquisitely through covers. Fakhar Zaman runs to his left and puts in a dive to stop the ball. He gets there but seems to have touched the rope as he does not get up and go after the ball after pulling it back. He signals it as a boundary. The umpire still goes upstairs and replays confirm his right arm was touching the cushion as he touched the ball.
Play and a miss. Length ball outside off, Eoin looks to hit it but misses.
Shorter on off, Root pulls it away for a single.
Eoin Morgan is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! The break has done the trick for Pakistan. Hasan pulls his length back and bowls it short to Jason. The ball hurries onto him, he looks to pull but gets no timing on it and top edges it. It goes high in the air towards mid on. Roy was furious as soon as he mishit it. Imad Wasim there takes a dolly. 87 strikes.
Back of a length ball on off, Root pulls it to deep mid-wicket with minimum fuss and gets to the other end.
Length ball on off, Roy strokes it to sweeper cover for a run.
On the stumps, Joe calmly blocks it to see off the over.
Flighted on middle, Roy looks to go inside out but gets an inside edge onto his pads. They take a run as the ball goes to point.
On middle and leg, Root milks it to long on for a run.
On middle and leg, Jason brings out the reverse sweep and hits it towrads backward point for a run.
Once again tossed up on off, Jason pushes it to the same fielder.
Floated on off, Roy clamly pushes it to mid off.
Risky shot for a single. Back of a length ball on off, Roy uppercuts it wide of third man and gets to the other end. He looked in control as he played that.
Full ball on off, Root drives it through covers for a run.
1323 Local. Good news. The covers are coming off and it should not be long before we resume play. We are hearing that it is a 1330 Local start. So we are very close from resumption.
The umpire's have decided to go off. On come the ground staff with the covers. Let us hope it is not a long delay.
Length and around off, Root opens the face and guides it to point.
On the fuller side on off, it is driven through covers for a single.
Looks like the heavens have opened up and it has started to rain. The bad news is, it is getting slightly heavier. The umpires though are happy to continue, let's hope it is just a passing shower.
Length and just outside off, it is guided down to third man for a single.
On the fuller side on middle, it is hit to mid on.
WIDE! A short one and it bounces way over the batsman's head. Wided.
Now defends it to see off the over. Flighted on middle, Jason takes no risk and calmly blocks it.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Sohail tosses it up on off, Roy smacks it over covers for a boundary.
In the air but safe. Floated on middle and off, Joe looks to sweep it but gets a top edge wide of short fine leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Roy nudges it to long on for a run.
Flighted on middle and leg, Jason reverse sweeps it but finds the man at short third man.
Floated on middle and leg, Roy defends it off his front foot.
Length ball outside off, Jason slashes it hard but straight to the man at deep cover-point.

Excellent ball. Good length ball comes in sharply after pitching. It skids off the surface, Root looks to pull but misses and gets hit high on the knee roll. The ball goes towards point and they take a leg bye.
Good length ball on off, Root gets behind the line of it and blocks it.
Full on off, Root flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, Roy looks to defend but it goes to the on side off the inner half of his bat for a run.
On off, Root strokes it to sweeper cover and gets a single.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
On off, Roy defends it to see off the over.
Smart batting this. Sohail floats it up on off, Root paddle sweeps it wide of short fine leg and gets three.
FOUR! Short on off, Root picks the length early and pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Root calmly defends it off his front foot.
Floated on off, Root blocks it.
Tossed up on the pads, Root sweeps it to the man at short fine leg.
Haris Sohail is on!
On middle and leg now, Root glances it to deep mid-wicket for a run. 150 comes up for England with that. They are cruising in at this moment. Pakistan desperately need a wicket here.
Good delivery. Length ball comes in to the batsman after hitting the deck. Root looks to run it down but it goes between his bat and pad to the keeper.
Back of a length on off, Roy pulls it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Outside off, Root runs it down to third man for a run.
Full on off, Roy comes down and nudges it to long on and gets a single.
Length ball around off, Root tucks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on off, Root pushes it to mid off and takes a run.
Now smartly follows it up with a single.  Just nudges the ball to long on and jogs for a run.

SIX! What a shot! Floated outside off, Roy goes inside out and smashes it over covers. The ball just bounces on the ropes. Replays roll in to see whether it was six or four and it confirms that it hit the cushion first.
Yorker on middle, Roy taps it back to the bowler.
Slightly short outside off, Roy cuts it but straight to point.
Tossed up on off, Root milks it to long on and gets an easy run.
Yasir Shah to bowl another one.
FOUR! Not a lot of power but just pure placement. Length ball outside off, Roy tucks it wide of long on and gets a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, Root defends it with soft hands and rotates the strike.
Full outside off, Root pushes it to the man at mid off.
Almost chopped on. Faheem slightly pulls his length back, Roy looks to cut but gets an inside edge which misses the stumps and goes towards fine leg. They take a run.
Once again on a length outside off, Roy comes down and defends it towards cover. Root was asking for a single but Roy said no.
Length ball around off, Root taps it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
This is swept nicely through square leg for a run.
A yorker on middle, Root jams it out.
FOUR! Brilliant placement! The quicker one but there is room on offer outside off, Root goes back and then guides it late, through backward point for a boundary. Used the pace excellently there.
Roy this time strokes it down to long on for one.
Root eases it down to long on for one.
Very full and outside off, it is jammed out to short third man.
On the pads again, it is worked through square leg for one. Another tight over comes to an end. Good going from Pakistan after the wicket.
A little too straight and this is flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Well fielded! Saves a boundary. Full and on middle, Root strokes it back towards the bowler who gets down in time and stops it, not cleanly but no runs conceded.
A low full toss on middle, Root looks to play the on-drive but it goes off the bottom part to mid on.
Back of a length around off, Root guides it to point.
Well bowled! That wicket must have given Shaheen some confidence. He steams in and bowls a very full ball. Root gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Another single down to long off this time for Root. Just the 4 from the over.
A low full toss on middle, Roy eases it down to long off for another one.
On the stumps, Roy lunges and keeps it out.
Root is off the mark as he strokes it through covers for one.
The slider on off, Joe Root goes back and blocks it.
A full toss on off, it is hit down to long off for a single.
Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... and that is a brilliant, brilliant catch. Bairstow can't believe it and nor can we as Pakistan have been extremely poor in the field today. The change of angle for Afridi and the change of bowling for Pakistan has worked wonders. A much-needed wicket for Pakistan. Shaheen comes around the wicket and bowls it short and on the body. Bairstow pulls it hard but hits it a little too flat. Zaman at deep square leg, runs to his right, then leaps, tries to take it reverse cup but the ball pops out but he keeps his eyes on it and hangs on in the second attempt. 50 and out for JB and Shaheen is delighted. Pakistan now need to build on this.

FOUR! Poor, poor bowling! A freebie for Bairstow to get to his half ton. 9th in ODIs! He would love to make it a big one here. This is short and down the leg side, JB helps it on its way to the fine leg boundary.
Another two! On the leg side again, JB works it fine on the leg side, it is a little wide from the fielder there and two results.
Excellent running! Bairstow flicks it with soft hands towards mid-wicket. They run the first one quickly, then go for the second and complete it with ease.
The slower one and it is on the shorter side, Bairstow looks to pull but it does not bounce as much as he expected it to. Hits him on the elbow.
A little too straight to begin with, Roy works it through backward square leg. He almost slips after playing the shot but keeps his balance and then completes a run.
Shaheen Afridi is back!
A single to end! So a good comeback after going for a boundary early on in the over. Just 5 from it. This is eased down to long off for a single.
Well bowled! This is bowled flatter and just outside off, it is the slider again. Roy gets beaten as he is a touch late in his shot. He tried to hit it through the off side again.
Drags his length back and it is quicker outside off, Roy looks to cut but misses. It zipped through.
Another one of those very full deliveries, Roy once agan jams it out but this time to covers.
FOUR! In the air... catch it is the call but it is away from the fielder! Lovely shot. Roy stays leg side of this floated delivery on the off stump, he hits it wide of long off for a boundary.
Very full, almost a yorker on off, Roy jams it out back to the bowler.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Around middle and off, Bairstow works it through mid-wicket for a couple. A couple taken to bring the 100-RUN STAND.
Steps back to the leg side and hammers this down to long off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, punched through mid off for a single.

DRINKS BREAK. Business as usual for England. Bat first, score quick, keep scoring quicker and pile on pressure on the opposition. In form, both Roy and Bairstow are devastating. Pakistan would want a wicket soon, though they might rue the run out chance missed of Bairstow.
FOUR! Cracking shot to end the over! Long hop, around middle, Bairstow rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary! 13 from the over.
HALF CENTURY FOR JASON ROY! His 13th in ODIs. Always has the penchant for scoring big in the first game of a series. Outside off, punched off the back foot through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played. Full and outside off, Roy brings out his reverse sweep and gets it past a diving short third man!
Around middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. Two runs added to the total.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Yasir Shah into the attack.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT. Umpire's call stays! Fired in down the leg side Bairstow misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Sarfaraz screams his lungs out but the umpire stays unperturbed. The ball goes to short fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye. The keeper and bowler have a chat and decide to take the review. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be clipping leg stump.
Huge LBW shout! Not given! Is Bairstow in trouble? Pakistan review. Looks to be missing leg...
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

SAFE! Imad has made a mess of a simple run out chance. Full and around middle, Roy comes down the track and looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off his pads towards backward point and Roy takes a couple of steps but is not sure where the ball has gone. Bairstow jogs right down the track and is almost within handshaking distance to Jason. He has to turn back and a run out is on offer. The throw comes in a good pace to Imad and the bails are off but the first thing we hear from Sarfaraz is 'KYA YAAR!' Replays show why as Imad appeals and celebrates. Before the throw comes in, Wasim disturbs the bails with his left hand. What a reprieve for Jonny. He was not even in the frame before he dived after the throw came in.
Run out? Or missed out? Looks like Imad has broken the stumps with his hand.
A length ball outside off, Bairstow looks to work it to the leg side but is beaten by the slowness of the pitch. He is early into the shot and misses his tuck, getting hit on the thigh pads.
Another short ball, extra bounce, Jason adjusts nicely by arching back and guiding it towards third man for a single.
WIDE. A bouncer way too high, outside off, Roy lets it go and Sarfaraz has to leap to collect.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.

That is a run stolen. Full and outside off, Roy slashes hard and there is a noise as the ball goes past. Seemed like an inside edge but the ball does not carry to Sarfaraz. He gets a bad bounce and fumbles and the batsmen pinch a run. Bye signalled from the umpire though.
A length ball around off and middle, Bairstow turns this around the corner towards fine leg for a single.
Full and around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, Roy looks to cut but the ball skids through and goes off the outside edge towards short third man.
Backs away and works this through mid on but short mid-wicket intercepts with a dive to his left.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
Down the leg side, helped towards fine leg. 'ONLY ONE!' yells Sarfaraz to his fielder.
Full and outside off, punched wide of mid off for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total. 12 from the over.

FOUR! Streaky! That is unlucky for Hasan Ali. Outside off, on a length, Roy looks to punch it through the off side but the ball nips back in, takes the inside edge and scurries over the stumps to the fine leg fence!
FOUR! That is too good a shot. A short ball outside off, Roy comes forward and plays a flick-pull. More of a flick, less of a pull but the ball races in front of deep mid-wicket and beats him!
Pushes this wide of mid on for three runs.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
A short ball outside off, Bairstow lets that pass him.
Goes back and nudges it through square leg for one more.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Down the leg side, Bairstow just milks it through mid-wicket, sees the empty space and jogs back for the second. This is a big ground.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a quick single.
Backs away to the leg side and has a hack, is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Close call. Fired down the leg side, Roy looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits Sarfaraz' gloves and hits the stumps. There is a stumping appeal but no one is going anywhere.
POWERPLAY 2 time! Four fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Excellent from both batsmen. Full and outside off, Roy taps it towards point, looks at Bairstow and then both are off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and around off, driven straight back down the ground.
A short ball, pulled straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A length ball, outside off, Roy swings hard but the slow pitch induces an inside edge. The ball goes wide of mid-wicket and the batsmen return for the second. Sarfaraz has his yelling going on...
Hasan Ali is the new bowler.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a run.

50-RUN STAND IS UP! Terrific start from England. A player who has just come off a terrific season in the Indian T20 League joining forces who has been missing cricket due to injury woes. Together, they have eased out all fears of rustiness. Roy comes down the track and works it wide of mid on for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Roy has now skipper past Bairstow.
Follows the batsman down the leg side, Roy can only push it back to Imad.
On middle and leg, punched back to the bowler.
Full and around off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off, short in length, worked wide of mid on for a run. 10 from the over.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.

SIX! Wow. Is hitting a biggie over cover a fashion these days or what? We saw a couple in the last 2-3 days in the Indian T20 League and now Roy plays one. A length ball, outside off, Roy stands tall and lofts it cleanly over cover! Back spasm? Who, Roy?
A bumper, hardly comes at pace, Bairstow calmly pulls this through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Loose from JR. Full and outside off, Roy looks to leather this through the off side but the ball comes on slowly and goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid on. A single taken.
Good bowling from Faheem. Sees Roy jump out and digs it in short. Jason  bails out of the shot and sways away.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for one more.
Works it through the leg side for a run.

Tea pots from the captain. Sarfaraz is furious with his fielders. Full and around middle, Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket and tests the fitness of the Pakistan fielders by running two. Sarfaraz is not happy with the effort and is about to say something but keeps mum.
Arrowed in on middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket.

EDGED, BUT NOT SLIP! Why, oh Sarfaraz, why? Quicker one outside off, Roy looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. There is no soul in the slip region and the ball races away. Faheem Ashraf gives it a good chase from short third man and pulls the ball back, parrying it to Afridi from short fine leg. Three runs taken.
Spin time. Imad Wasim into the attack.
Flicks this wide of mid on for a single.
Full and straight, watchfully pushed towards mid on.
Fuller, around off, pushed through the covers for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
No wide signalled. Did that hit the thigh pad? Faheem telegraphed that he is going to be bowling this cross-seam. But he directs this down the leg side. Roy looks to pull but misses.
Full and outside off, Roy is slowly getting his timing, as he drives it confidently towards mid off.

FOUR! Probably the easiest ball of the over for YJB to hit. A half-tracker, right in the middle of the pitch. Bairstow picks the length up in a trice and pulls it powerfully to the right of the man at deep mid-wicket. 12 from the over, England are up and running now.
Fullish, outside off, thumped powerfully but straight to mid off.

FOUR! Second one of the over. But not a bad ball. Dug in short, outside leg, a bit of a tester from Bairstow but he reacts well. He gets back and across to pull, is cramped for room but manages it to get it off the glove through the vacant fine leg region.
Outside off, a length ball again, punched straight to cover.
FOUR! Very strong there, is this Yorkshire lad. A length ball, around middle, Bairstow uses his bottom hand, gets his wrists into play and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
That is a lovely nut. Afridi comes in from over the wicket and lands it on a good length around off. Bairstow looks to defend but the ball moves away and then bounces a tad low. Jonny boy is beaten.
Lands this on a length outside off, Roy quietly pushes it towards cover. Nice comeback after the six by Faheem.
Mid on goes back. Fine leg and third man come up.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed back again.
Now he watchfully defends this like an obedient kid.

SIX! Gets out of jail! The release shot from Roy comes out at last and one won't die wondering. He is not a block-all-balls batsman and eventually connects one. Steps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and bang. Swings it cleanly over long on. First maximum of the day. That is the case with Bairstow and Roy. 3 overs 9, can quickly become 6 overs 50.
Play and a miss! No freebies from Pakistan. On a length outside off, Roy looks to play that to the off side but the ball swings away late and beats the outside edge.
Angling in from outside off, Bairstow confidently strides forward and works it wide of mid on for a single.

IN THE AIR... JUST WIDE! This is a good battle between Afridi and Roy. Full and around off, Roy walks into the shot again and looks for a flick. Again, he is early into the shot and another leading edge is induced. It is uppish and goes back to the bowler and Afridi sticks out his left hand. But the ball is just wide. Escapes past him and goes down the ground. Two runs taken. Roy is searching for some time in the middle. The bowling has been very good. Nothing loose so far.
Another change in the field. Fine leg comes up, square leg goes back.
Nicely played, with a full face of the bat, but there is an obstruction in the form of cover.
Yorker around off, watchfully dug out towards cover.
Leading edge, but safe. Full and around leg, Roy looks to flick but is early into his shot. The bat turns in his hands and the ball goes off the leading edge towards cover.
Walks into the shot, the ball comes in, goes off the inner half and rolls towards mid on.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Around off, pushed towards mid on for a quick run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Walks down the track and pushes it towards point.
Outside off, driven straight to cover.
That nips back in, from outside off, Roy looks to tuck but misses. The ball comes in  long way and hits him on the body.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed back.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl with the second new ball.
FOUR! Lovely shot to get underway! Full and around off, Bairstow drives this straight back past the bowler. Mid off tries to get across to his right but cannot do so.
On a length around middle, angling away, solidly defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Jonny gets across and lets it go.
Nice shot, driven straight down the ground but Afridi sticks out his left hand to parry it towards mid off.
Full and straight, hint of shape in, worked towards mid on.
Around middle and leg, Roy works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Out come the players for the home side and the visiting one. Jonny Bairstow and Jason Roy are the openers for England. Shaheen Afridi to start off proceedings to Roy. Here we go...
TEAM NEWS - The big news is that there is no Jofra Archer for England. Roy, Bairstow and Moeen Ali - all return to the English unit. For Pakistan, no Shoaib Malik, in spite of him being available.
TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and elected to bowl first.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd ODI between England and Pakistan in this 5-match series. After a wash out in the first game, we certainly expect a better day today, though there is the prediction of intermittent showers. At one side we have hosts who are eager to test their strength and keep their momentum running after a victory in the T20 game, while the visitors would be keen get a win up against their name and prove their worth. Jofra Archer already have eyes on him and he will be having great confidence after his spell in London. It's a mouth-watering clash, so sit back and relax while we bring you the coverage of this vital ODI match.
